text:
hana (Eng): Quick weird one  urgent care billed me as out-of-network because the clinic said the member ID on my physical card doesn't match their system. My digital card (in the HR portal) shows ID 77001122 but the printed card I got last month shows 077001122. They insisted leading zero matters and billed me self-pay. Claim #999334455. Anyone run into leading-zero issues?

leo (People Ops): Oof, yes  insurer canonical ID sometimes pads to 10 digits or drops leading zeros depending on system. Which plan are you on and can you attach pics of both cards and the EOB?

hana (Eng): RW-PPO-2025. Uploaded photo_physical.jpg and screenshot_digital.png and EOB.pdf. Provider said their portal requires the insurer-issued 10-digit ID, not our short format.

benefits-bot: Plan lookup: RW-PPO-2025 (UnitedCare). Member canonical insurer ID: UC-0077001122. HR-issued short ID: 77001122. Advice: when contacting providers give the insurer canonical ID (UC-0077001122) and DOB. For claims already paid as self-pay, file a member appeal with UnitedCare attaching EOB and both card images. UnitedCare appeals: https://unitedcare.example/appeals or 1-800-555-9012.

leo (People Ops): I'll open an internal ticket and ping the broker. In the meantime file the online appeal using benefits-bot wording and attach the screenshots. Want a short copy to paste?

hana (Eng): Yes please  also I paid $145 at the clinic, can Finance help while this gets sorted?

sasha (Broker): Hi Hana  I can escalate to UnitedCare if the provider insists on the wrong format. Typical resolution: provider rebills with insurer canonical ID or UnitedCare reprocesses using the canonical mapping. I'll request re-adjudication once appeal is filed.

leo (People Ops): Paste this into the appeals portal or read to the rep:

"""
To UnitedCare Member Services,

Please review Claim #999334455 for services dated 2025-07-08 billed by City Urgent Care. The claim was processed as out-of-network due to a member ID mismatch: the provider used the printed card number (077001122) which is formatted differently from the insurer canonical ID (UC-0077001122). The enrollee's digital HR card shows 77001122. Please reprocess the claim under in-network benefits and adjust member liability accordingly. Attached: EOB, physical card photo, digital card screenshot, receipt of payment.

Thank you,
[Member Name]
"""

viv (Finance): If you paid out-of-pocket and need temporary support, Finance can approve a reimbursement advance up to $200 while the appeal is pending. DM me the receipt and amount and I'll trigger it.

hana (Eng): Filing the appeal now and DMing Viv. Leo/Sasha  please cc me on any broker/insurer escalations. I'll update the thread with the UnitedCare case number when I get it. Thanks everyone :slightly_smiling_face:
